results.title: Shooter
results.overview: A former professional biathlonist is disillusioned with life and has no ambitions left, but his new pupil – a boy with Down syndrome – forces him to change and find a new meaning in life.

results.title: Treat Her Like a Lady
results.overview: When single mother Sandra, full of unwavering energy, is evicted from her apartment by the Dutch government due to fraud, she convinces her daughters Harrie and Stella that their emergency shelter is a holiday hotel. Taking care of her children while being the main breadwinner seems impossible, but Sandra won't go down without a fight: with heroism and creativity, she gives her daughters the best summer of their lives.

results.title: A Good Hand Wasted
results.overview: A luxury island getaway turns deadly when six friends join a mysterious dealer's poker game, where every losing hand means a round of Russian roulette.

results.title: Bestiario
results.overview: In a dystopian Spain, a journalist is captured by mutants after publishing provocative articles. Forced to take part in a theatrical parody based on her own critiques, she uncovers the hidden world of an excluded, surviving society.

results.title: Fire, Water, Earth, Air
results.overview: Four stories from the Nordic region paint a picture of a changing natural world, where the elements rage and where being prepared proves to be much more than sandbags and fire extinguishers.

results.title: Alchemy
results.overview: A girl discovers she has a unique sexual chemistry which creates a mysterious substance that takes over her life and everyone else in the city.

results.title: Habeebi
results.overview: Follows a boy and girl in a Muslim neighbourhood in southern Tamil Nadu whose romance divides their community.

results.title: The Waves Will Carry Us
results.overview: When Ah Yao returns to Malaysia for his father’s funeral, he expects grief, not chaos. But everything turns upside down when the religious police storm in, claiming his father—who secretly converted to Islam—must be buried in an Islamic cemetery. Refusing to let go, Ah Yao and his siblings set out on a wild, darkly comedic journey to reclaim the body, confronting cultural clashes, family secrets, and absurd obstacles along the way.

results.title: Alien Spa
results.overview: Three siblings, grieving the death of their parents, have a spa day from hell (or shall we say... from space).

results.title: A Love Like This
results.overview: Paul and Leah, in a tale of two lovers, rent a Malibu beach house for the weekend, but there's more to their relationship than it seems.

results.title: Extázis Uncut
results.overview: An album film for Bongor’s award-winning EXTÁZIS, following the artist’s struggle with addiction. Blending fictional and documentary elements, this genre-defining work is driven by the album’s songs.

results.title: Twist & Shoot: Mister Suzuki
results.overview: Seijun Suzuki became a cinema legend in the 1960s with a handful of pop-art films. So how can you make a portrait of this iconoclastic director without also adopting a 'style to kill' documentary convention, as well as testimonies from a variety of leading figures in contemporary Japanese and international filmmakers.

results.title: Nevermind
results.overview: In the neon-lit streets of Kolkata, a woman searching for redemption crosses paths with a mysterious bar singer whose past remains hidden. Over the course of a restless day, their lives intertwine with strangers carrying their own conflicts and secrets, until a buried truth changes everything.

results.title: Be Happy
results.overview: Follows 50-year-old Val, a devoted wife and stay-at-home mom who seeks to reignite the spark in her marriage after her child heads to college.

results.title: Samurai Vengeance
results.overview: In January 1810 in Edo, Kikunosuke, the 17-year-old-son of a murdered samurai, takes revenge on his father's murderer, Sakubai, who was his father's former retainer. Kikunosuke gloriously defeats the swaggering Sakubai in single combat in front of a theater, witnessed by a huge audience that had just finished watching a production of 47 Ronin. With Sakubai's severed head, Kikunosuke has achieved his revenge and ensured that his family won't be exiled. 18 months later, a ronin named Soichiro Kase from Kikunosuke's domain arrives at the theater. While he seems silly and smooth-talking, he's very keen on finding out more about the incident and Kikunosuke's time working at the theater. The theater's staff – the barker Ippachi, the swordsmanship teacher Sagara, the costumer Hotaru, the craftsman Kyuzo, and the playwright Kinji – are apprehensive and suspicious at his digging. However, not everything is as it seems.

results.title: Alien in the Heartland
results.overview: Amidst growing fears of an alien invasion with shapeshifting capabilities, a paranoid widower imprisons two sisters seeking refuge, convinced one is an extraterrestrial.

results.title: Les 50 décisions qui ont coulé la France
results.original_title: Les 50 décisions qui ont coulé la France

results.title: Her Ciro
results.overview: A radio tower operator calls his wife in wartime.

results.title: A Super Progressive Movie
results.overview: Melbourne is the last bastion of "The Progressives," a society shielded from the outside world by a glowing rainbow "virtue signal." When the shield begins to fail, an Aboriginal elder named Murray reveals the truth: the culture war was lost long ago, and only the legendary Victimhood can save them. Tasked with retrieving it is Pete, a downtrodden white man treated as the lowest rung of society. Joined by Murray, the vain Princess Stacey, and Social Justice Warrior Lance, Pete ventures into the "real" Australia for the first time, discovering it's nothing like he was told — while Prime Minister Pauline Hanson races to reach the weapon first.

results.title: Hotel Papucaia
results.overview: Lucas and Brian are looking for a hotel called Hotel Papucaia, but things don't go quite as they expected.
